50.description: This feature vector represents common prefixes and sub-word roots in the Hindi language.

34.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi word suffixes, prefixes, and character combinations.

128.description: This vector represents common Hindi suffixes, postpositions, and verb root fragments.

26.description: This vector represents common Hindi vowel signs, dependent vowel modifiers, and consonant-vowel clusters.

182.description: This vector activates on various Hindi vowel sign (matra) characters combined with a comma or punctuation mark.

188.description: This vector represents Hindi character sequences and consonant-vowel combinations involving the letter 'ह' (ha).

150.description: This vector represents Hindi conditional, temporal, and interrogative conjunctions and adverbial roots.

140.description: This vector represents characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens belonging to the Devanagari script alongside isolated punctuation and English sub-words.

61.description: This feature vector represents numerical values corresponding to human ages.

132.description: This feature vector activates on fragments of Hindi text and specific Devanagari script components.
